item.text: {"decision":"The searched collection does not contain the retained inspection photographs or measurements. D01 provides only limited initial observations: the keeper plate was found bolted to the recovered assembly, and beam/yoke fracture was not reported. Detailed keeper/fastener condition, deformation measurements, seating/contact geometry, lateral-offset or dynamic-path marks, and impact/contact evidence remain unanswered pending production of the retained inspection photos/measurements or a custodian answer.","operations":[{"action":"revise","expected_version":2,"replaces":null,"reason":"Coverage of requested fields from searched sources D01, D02, D04, and D15: (1) keeper plate condition and fastener state: partially answered only as to presence/bolting. D01.S02 reports the keeper plate was found bolted to the recovered assembly, but supplies no photograph, fastener count/torque, loosening, damage, deformation, witness marks, or preservation history. (2) beam and yoke fracture or deformation evidence: partially answered only as to fracture reporting. D01.S02 says the beam and yoke were not reported fractured, but this is an initial observation and gives no inspection photographs, dimensional checks, deformation assessment, crack-test scope, or measurement sensitivity. (3) primary seating engagement or wear/contact measurements: not answered. D02.S05 defines the 30 mm primary seating engagement rule and states keeper engagement requires separate evidence, but no event inspection measurement or wear/contact observation is supplied. (4) lateral offset indicators and dynamic path marks: not answered. D02.S05 states lateral offset and dynamic path require their own evidence; no incident photographs, witness marks, scrape paths, or offset measurements are present. D15.S01 suggests excess clearance only as an unreviewed interpretation and D15.S02 says it contains no retention-envelope calculation or independent witness account. (5) impact/contact evidence at sled, scaffold, mill post, or spreader: partially answered only for occurrence of sled/scaffold strike. D01.S01 reports the beam struck the sled and scaffold platform, but no inspection photos, impact marks, contact locations, mill-post/spreader contact observations, or measurements are provided. D04 concerns procedure/isolation and does not supply inspection evidence. This is a partial answer and a search/collection gap, not explicit unavailability; reopening/completion condition is production of retained inspection photographs, measurement sheets, preservation/chain-of-custody notes, NDE/dimensional inspection records, or a custodian answer identifying their contents for the recovered R3 carrier beam, YK-3, keeper, sled/scaffold, mill-post, and spreader contact areas after the 13:24 event.","record":{"id":"R_R3InspectionPhotos","kind":"request","scope_key":"r3_recovered_assembly_inspection_photos_measurements_2024-10-14","claim":"Obtain and assess inspection photographs and measurements to document recovered component condition, keeper/seating geometry, lateral offset indicators, and impact/contact evidence relevant to the R3 beam release path.","status":"partial","sources":["D01","D02","D04","D15"],"depends_on":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":"R3 recovered carrier beam, yoke YK-3, keeper plate, sled, scaffold, and adjacent mill-post/spreader contact areas","window":"post-event recovery/inspection following 13:24 event on 14 October 2024, with preservation history if available","fields":["detailed keeper plate condition and fastener state beyond bolted presence","beam and yoke deformation, crack-test scope, or measurement evidence beyond initial no-fracture report","primary seating engagement or wear/contact measurements","lateral offset indicators and dynamic path marks","impact/contact evidence at sled, scaffold, mill post, or spreader beyond reported sled/scaffold strike"]}}],"next_work":[],"upstream_dispositions":[],"disposition":"partial"}
